paragraphs.text: Windows taskbar unread badge and window-bounds restore for DeepSeek Harness.
# DSH Taskbar Badge
A Windows taskbar overlay badge for DeepSeek Harness that shows how many conversations finished whil
e you were not looking. The same helper also remembers and restores the DSH window size and position
across Harness restarts.
## Features

- Blue count badge on the DSH taskbar icon, like Codex/Teams unread badges.
- Counts completed, unre

ad DSH conversations (subagent and archived sessions are ignored).
- Works while DSH is minimized, i

n the background, or has its sidebar collapsed.
- Restores the DSH window bounds from the previous c

lose, including the maximized state.
- Starts with Harness through the plugin host half; there is no

Windows Startup-folder entry.
- Windows only. On other platforms the plugin loads but does nothing.
## Requirements

- Windows 10 or Windows 11.
- A DSH desktop build that supports plugin bundles (`dsh.bundle`).
- .NE
T Framework 4.x (included with Windows 10/11), because the helper is a small .NET executable.
## Install
### From the plugin market
Once the plugin is listed, open **DSH → Plugins → Plugin Market**, search for **DSH Taskbar Badge**,
and install it. Restart Harness fully after installation.
### From GitHub
In **DSH → Plugins → Add plugin**, enter:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
You can also paste the full repository URL: `https://github.com/HUHUhim/dsh-taskbar-badge`.
Then fully quit and restart Harness. The bundle layer is assembled at startup, so a page refresh is
quit and restart Harness. The bundle layer is assembled at startup, so a page refresh is not enough.
> Migrating from the local development version? Uninstall `dsh-taskbar-badge-bridge` first. It uses
the same helper and would otherwise run a second title watcher.
After the restart, the taskbar icon should get a blue number badge when another conversation complet
es. Opening that conversation clears its unread count.
## How it works
The package has two halves:
1. **Client half** (`client.js`) is a renderless DSH client plugin. It watches the session store and
writes a `[N] ` prefix into the document title when there are `N` completed, unread sessions. Nothi

ng is shown inside the app UI.
2. **Host half** (`index.js`, inserted by `cordis.patch.yml`) starts
the bundled `bin/dsh-taskbar-badge.exe` when Harness starts.
The helper reads the `[N]` prefix from the DSH window title. If the prefix is absent it falls back t
o counting completed rows in the sidebar through Windows UI Automation. Every 800 ms it calls `ITask
barList3.SetOverlayIcon` with a generated 24×24 badge, so minimized windows and collapsed sidebars d
verlayIcon` with a generated 24×24 badge, so minimized windows and collapsed sidebars do not matter.
For window bounds, the helper uses `GetWindowPlacement` / `SetWindowPlacement`, saves the normal rec
tangle to `%LOCALAPPDATA%\DSH\window-bounds.txt`, and clamps it to the monitor work area on restore.
## Privacy and security

- No network access and no telemetry.
- Reads only the DSH window title and, as a fallback, DSH side

bar status rows through Windows UI Automation.
- Writes local diagnostics and state under `%LOCALAPP

DATA%\DSH\`:
- `taskbar-badge.log`
- `taskbar-badge-bridge.log`
- `window-bounds.txt`
- The helper i
s an unsigned .NET executable. Windows SmartScreen may warn the first time; the full C# source is in
`bin/dsh-taskbar-badge.cs` and can be rebuilt locally.
## Build the helper from source
The release binary is committed at `bin/dsh-taskbar-badge.exe`. To rebuild it:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The script uses the .NET Framework 4.x `csc.exe` and the WPF UI Automation reference assemblies that
ship with Windows. It writes `bin/dsh-taskbar-badge.exe` in place.
## Uninstall

1. Remove **dsh-taskbar-badge** from the DSH plugin list.
2. Quit Harness, then end any remaining `d

sh-taskbar-badge.exe` process.
3. Optionally delete `%LOCALAPPDATA%\DSH\taskbar-badge.log`, `taskbar
-badge-bridge.log`, and `window-bounds.txt`.
No Windows startup entry is created, so there is nothing to remove from `shell:startup`.
